author: Fluffster
title: Artist wanted for game splash, HUD, and icons
content: ARTIST WANTED: I am currently working on a game, this game is all self worked, funded and coded. I am looking for an artist to do the SPLASH SCREEN for it. It is currently AI generated (For placeholders). But do not want the game to be AI at all. The project has been worked on for 6 months now and will probably be another 6 months to a year before it is finished. Please reach out in this post if you are interested in doing the art work for it. I am currently talking to several people now. I will be making a selection for the Artist for this job in a week or so. VISION: The game does not have a story yet. But I am working on that. However it is called Planetary Plains. A lower Polygon style Rogue-Like Tower Climber game, the protagonist is a Stick-Figure guy wearing a backpack. It is a Steam-Punk/Cyber-Punk style theme and feel to the game. He goes from Planet to Planet killing robots and bosses for some reason (Still no story). Some screen shots are added for the current state of the game and vibe of it. If you are interested in doing the splash screen, HUD's and ICONS. Please let me know in replies. And I will reach out to you in DM's for further discussion. Contact: reply on the post; they will DM.
